summary: P1/P2 security hardening: headers, logout CSRF, API token idle/expiry, trusted proxies, backup download POST, CSV import type checks, logs deny.

changes: Send CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS on HTTPS
Configurable via security_headers; trusted_proxies for LoginThrottle
POST /logout with CSRF; account menu uses form submit
E2E auth helper posts logout with meta csrf-token
Default expiry 7 days; last_used_at + idle timeout (default 72h)
Profile CSV import validates .csv extension and MIME
Playwright coverage for headers, logout CSRF, backup GET block, logs, token expiry
